text:
sylvia_marketing: Quick sync — DeepHarbor case study. Customer ok to do an interview next week but we need transcript, release, and localized microcopy before publish. Can someone own orchestration?

 tim_se: Ill take the tech portion. Available Mon 18:00 CET (Tue 9am PT). Will bring P95/P50 charts and a config snippet. Planning short demo of the routing policy we used.

 lisa_editor: I can handle transcript+first-draft quotes. Will run Otter, then hand-edit. Request: are we allowed to publish raw latency numbers?

 ana_prod: Customer agreed to a 1-week embargo. Marketing can set it. Legal needs to approve numeric claims  tagging @marc_legal.

 marc_legal: Confirmed  need signed testimonial release before any quoted metrics. Uploaded redline: https://drive.redwood.company/DeepHarbor-release-redline. If they refuse numbers, fallback language: "measurable reductions in latency and cost".

 jamie_ops: Ill set up Zoom with recording + captions and enable recording to Drive. Invite pending.

 sylvia_marketing: Interview prompts: 1) What was the infra pain before? 2) Concrete before/after (cost/latency) OR qualitative fallback, 3) Day-to-day ops changes and saved time. Ask for short-sentence answers for social.

 lisa_editor: After call Ill post: - two quote variants (1-sentence, paragraph) - 150-word case blurb - 3 pull quotes for social. Can @ana_loc estimate ES/DE microcopy turnaround? Need glossary link.

 ana_loc: I can localize ES + DE microcopy within 48h after final copy. Please use https://redwood.internal/docs/glossary for product terms.

 tim_se: Ill screen-share the dashboard and export the P95 graph as PNG during the call. Also prepping a 2-paragraph technical appendix describing model variants and routing policy for the case page.

 marc_legal: Reminder: testimonial release must be signed by customer contact (send to marie@deepharbor.ai). If they want anonymized metrics, we can use percentages or relative language but still require the release.

 sylvia_marketing: Great. My action list: 1) confirm slot & send invite, 2) record call + screenshots, 3) transcribe + draft quotes, 4) send release to customer + get signature, 5) finalize copy -> localization -> schedule social & webinar mention. Ill ping Marie now.

 jamie_ops: Invite sent to Marie (marie@deepharbor.ai). Zoom link + calendar invite. Recording on.

 lisa_editor: Post-call plan: I'll drop draft quotes here. Target Wed EOD for final copy so we can wire landing + webinar mention. If legal needs more time we'll push embargo accordingly. :rocket:

 sylvia_marketing: Thanks all. Small note: include a short "how we measured" line on the case page to be transparent about telemetry source.

 tim_se: Noted  will add an appendix section: "Measurements via Redwood telemetry, aggregated daily".

 lisa_editor: Copy posted after call. Will loop in @marc_legal for final sign-off before publishing.

 ana_loc: Once final copy is ready, I'll start localization and post localized microcopy here.

 marc_legal: I'll review the final quotes and the signed release when ready.

 sylvia_marketing: Perfect  moving to execute. Thanks everyone :clap:
